quasarmc_quasium.options.face_culling.to: Skips drawing the sides of blocks that point away from you. Never hides anything visible. Turn it off to compare FPS.
quasarmc_quasium.options.entity_lod.tool: Far players and mobs update their animation fewer times per second (60/30/15). Players: full speed within 64 blocks. Mobs reach each step at half the distance.
quasarmc_quasium.options.lod_panorama.to: Distant Horizons draws far terrain into a 360° picture around you that only refreshes as you move, instead of redrawing it every frame. Needs Quasar Horizons.
How far away the panorama takes over from live LOD drawing. Closer = faster, farther = more accurate when moving.
quasarmc_quasium.options.saturation.tool: How colorful the image is. 0% = black and white, 100% = unchanged, 200% = twice as vivid.
quasarmc_quasium.options.contrast.toolti: Difference between dark and bright. 100% = unchanged.
quasarmc_quasium.options.whiteness.toolt: How easily bright colors turn white. 50% = unchanged, higher = reaches white sooner (brighter, more washed highlights), lower = holds color in highlights. Blacks and full white stay put.
quasarmc_quasium.options.smooth_entity_l: Players and mobs fade smoothly between light levels instead of jumping a step at each block. Costs almost nothing.
quasarmc_quasium.options.round_light.too: Torches and other light blocks light the ground in a smooth circle instead of a diamond with visible steps. Visual only: mob spawning and crops still use normal light. Costs a little time when chunks are built near light sources (see the [Quasium] F3 line).
Held torches, dropped light items and burning mobs light up their surroundings. Smooth: the light follows every block you move. Balanced: up to ~5 moves a second. Eco: ~2 a second. Far-away lights update less often either way.
quasarmc_quasium.options.colored_light.t: Light takes the color of its source: torches warm orange, soul torches blue, copper torches green, redstone red. Needs Quasar Meshelium. Off = plain light (for comparing performance or weaker GPUs).
